title: Android Crash when showing a material that is both disable_receive_shadows = true and shading mode = "per-vertex" (2)
body:
### Tested versions

Tested this in 4.5.stable version, in Android, using default Vulkan, Mobile rendering.



### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable (f62fdbde1) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.4630) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 15.79 GiB memory

### Issue description


First I realized that a material, when showed in screen, crashed the game. It simply crashes without any error, making it really difficult for anyone to find it.

This is a very serious crash since I now have to search every single material for a per-vertex material, and change it back... and this was a pain to find!

### Steps to reproduce

Then I tried recreating the material, parameter by parameter, like this:

```gdscript
var stuff_to_do:Dictionary = {
	"resource_local_to_scene" : true,
	"render_priority" : 10,
	"cull_mode" : 2,
	"shading_mode" : 2,
	"diffuse_mode" : 3,
	"specular_mode" : 2,
	"disable_ambient_light" : true,
	"emission_enabled" : true,
	"emission" : Color(1, 1, 1, 1),
	"emission_energy_multiplier" : 5.0,
	"rim" : 0.5,
	"rim_tint" : 1.0,
	"disable_receive_shadows" : true,
	"grow_amount" : -0.252,
}

func _ready() -> void:
	print("Thingie ready! %s" % [stuff_to_do.size()]) #Just to see if I messed up
	await get_tree().create_timer(1).timeout
	var keys = stuff_to_do.keys()
	#keys.reverse()
	for key in keys: ##Go through the keys in the dictionary
		print("Changing %s to %s" % [key, stuff_to_do[key]])
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.25).timeout
		self.get_active_material(0).set(key, stuff_to_do[key]) ##Change parameter by parameter
		print("CHANGED %s to %s" % [key, stuff_to_do[key]])
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.25).timeout
```

So, when the dictionary hits the "disable_receive_shadows", it crashes the game. If I reverse the keys, it crashes the game when it reached the shading_mode = 2, so both are linked.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[empty-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23325457/empty-test.zip)

You'll have to make a Android build template folder!
